mapper.sql: v.id, v.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, v.category_id, vc.name AS category_name, v.title, v.description, v.file_path, v.status, v.published_at, v.deleted_at, s.current_like_count, s.current_favorite_count, s.play_count, s.unique_viewer_count, s.share_count, s.valid_comment_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM videos v JOIN users u ON u.id = v.author_id JOIN video_categories vc ON vc.id = v.category_id JOIN v_video_statistics s ON s.video_id = v.id WHERE v.id = #{id} AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED'
